text.p: Digital Generation Systems Inc said Monday that it bought the Mediatech/Starcom subsidiary of IndeNet Inc.

Mediatech/Starcom's core business is the delivery of television commercials and syndicated television programming to television stations, cable systems and other television providers, a news release from Digital said.
In its fiscal year ended March 31, 1997, Mediatech/Starcom had revenues of $23.4 million, the release said.
With this acquisition, Digital becomes the nation's largest provider of broadcast advertising distribution services, the release said.

Digital said it agreed to issue Series A preferred stock to a group of institutional investors led by investment affiliates of Dawson-Samberg Capital Management Inc, subject to certain conditions including the closing of the Mediatech purchase.

Under the agreement, the release said, a group of investors including Pequot Private Equity Fund and other investment affiliates of Dawson-Samberg, Integral Capital Partners and Technology Crossover Ventures will invest a total of $17.5 million.
